cached_input_tokens.description: Subset of `input_tokens`; `None` when no row recorded it.

requests.description: Provider calls in the turn, retries included — each is a billed call.

unmeasured_requests.description: Calls whose provider reported no usage at all.

UiUnfinishedGoal.description: One goal that still owes work.

driving.description: A turn is still running for it — it is being driven right now, and is therefore not unfinished work.

opened_at.description: RFC3339. When the goal was opened.

ours.description: Whether this runtime may act on it. `false` means another runtime holds the task; the goal is still listed, because omitting work that exists is worse than naming work nobody here can act on.

session_id.description: The conversation it ran in, so the user can go read it.

windows_run.description: Work windows it consumed before stopping.

UiUsageReport.description: What one scope spent, with the range the runtime resolved it to.

cached_input_tokens.description: Subset of `input_tokens`, summed over rows that recorded a cache figure. `None` when no row in scope recorded one.

cost_usd_micros.description: Sum over rows that carried a price. `None` when none did — the honest answer, never `$0.00`.

from.description: Resolved lower bound (inclusive), RFC 3339. `None` = unbounded below.

generated_at.description: When the runtime computed this report (RFC 3339).

models.description: Per provider/model breakdown, largest spender first.

priced_requests.description: Rows whose cost is part of `cost_usd_micros`.

reasoning_tokens.description: Subset of `output_tokens`, summed over rows that reported a breakdown. `None` when no row in scope did.

to.description: Resolved upper bound (exclusive), RFC 3339. `None` = the report covers everything up to the moment it was generated.

unmeasured_requests.description: Calls in scope whose provider reported no usage. They are counted as requests but contribute no tokens: an absence of measurement.

UiUsageScope.description:
The window a usage report covers.

The runtime — not the client — resolves a scope into an explicit `[from, to)` range and echoes it in the report, so two surfaces showing the same scope can never disagree about its boundary.

oneOf.description: The session's latest turn (the running one, else the last one).
Everything the current session ever spent.
The caller's local calendar day.
The caller's local day six days ago through now.
The caller's local day twenty-nine days ago through now.
Every durable call this runtime's ledger holds.

UiUserShell.description: One user shell execution (`!command`) as the reconnect snapshot carries it: the active one plus a bounded recent history. `output_tail` is the bounded end of the combined output (never the full log).

elapsed_secs.description: Seconds elapsed at snapshot time (running/background) or total runtime (done).

full_output.description: The directory holding this execution's complete raw capture (`stdout.log`, `stderr.log`, `combined.log`) once the copy finished. A client reads the copy for "Copy Output"; it never parses display text to find it. `None` while the execution runs (the capture is still being written) or when the host could not complete one.

origin_command_id.description: The delivery identity of the command that produced this execution, when it arrived through a `CommandEnvelope`. It is the runtime's record of *which request* this execution answers, so a caller that owns the command id can find its own execution without matching command text. Absent for a raw `send` and for executions recorded before the field existed; never inferred from the command.

task_id.description: The registry task id when this execution runs in the background. The same execution id and process remain; this is the link to the background task list, not a second execution.

UserShellId.description: Identifies one user-originated shell execution (`!command`) — a session-scoped direct host execution. Deliberately NOT a [`ToolCallId`]: a user shell is not an agent tool call and never enters the model conversation.
